items.t: The S&P 500 Has a “Pure Value” Version. RPV Gives Its Cheapest Stocks the Biggest Weights
items.sum: Most S&P 500 funds hand the biggest weights to the market's winners. One lesser-known fund flips that logic, loading up on unloved health insurers, automakers, and refiners. Does it deserve a spot in a retiree's portfolio, or is the discount a trap?

items.t: Archer-Daniels-Midland Stock: Is Wall Street Bullish or Bearish?
items.sum: Though Archer-Daniels-Midland has outperformed relative to the broader market over the past year, Wall Street analysts maintain a cautious outlook on the stock’s prospects.

items.t: 3 Top-Ranked Dividend Stocks: A Smarter Way to Boost Your Retirement Income
items.sum: The traditional retirement planning approaches no longer cover all expenses in nest egg years. So what can retirees do? Thankfully, there are alternative investments that provide steady, higher-rate income streams to replace dwindling bond yields.
